key_insight: Statopia pairs an autonomous Lean 4 prover with an evolving statistics library to turn statements, with or without supplied proofs, into machine-checked results.
engineering_relevance: The ecosystem targets verifiable statistical and machine-learning theory through reusable formal infrastructure and parallel, resumable proof workflows.
method: Integrate source preparation, statement review, library-supported planning and Lean proof construction.
Coordinate long developments using dynamic proof dependency graphs and task groups.
Expand Statlib through reviewed updates informed by verified results and prover usage.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes the architecture and workflow but reports no benchmark results, success rates or quantitative evaluation.
watch_item: Machine checking validates the formal statement, so faithful reconstruction of source assumptions remains critical.
paper_title: Statopia: A Prover--Library Ecosystem for Automated Formalization and Proof Discovery in Statistics
